name: Monmusu Ranbu ~Mou Yamero, Ore no Seiryoku wa 0 Nanda...!~
original_name: もんむす乱舞　～もうやめろ、俺の精力は０なんだっ……！～
source:
Midnight. When Ren, the protagonist, reads magic words on a book.
He was born in a clan of wizards. He tries to summon some monsters before his ceremony of succession to get revenge...
